notes.title: Demo update: Performance Improvements and Leaderboard Fixes
notes.content:
Dear Sheep Seeker players,

We are excited to announce a new update that brings several enhancements to your gaming experience:
[list]
[*] Performance Improvements: We've addressed various performance issues to ensure smoother gameplay.​
[*] Customizable Performance Settings: A new settings menu has been added, allowing you to tailor performance options to your preferences.​
[*] Leaderboard Fixes: Issues affecting the leaderboard have been resolved, ensuring accurate rankings and a fair competitive environment.​
[/list]

We appreciate your feedback and support. Please continue to share your thoughts as we strive to make Sheep Seeker even better.​

Happy seeking!

notes.title: Solo Mode Unleashed + New Co-op Maps!
notes.content:
[b][h1]🎉 The New Sheep Seeker Update is LIVE! 🎉[/h1][/b]

[b][h2]Just in time for the Festival, we’re thrilled to announce a major update to the Sheep Seeker demo! 🐑[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280994/113251091779d8f4afbc71a4e510040f1ce23fda.png[/img]
[b][h2]What's New?[/h2][/b]

[list]
[*] ✅ [b]Solo Mode[/b] – 5 new solo levels to test your skills!
[*] ✅ [b]3 New Co-op Maps[/b] – More chaos, more fun!
[*] ✅ [b]Global Leaderboard[/b] – Compete for the top spot! 
[*] ✅ [b]Improved Physics[/b] – Smoother, faster, better!
[*] ✅ [b]Revamped UX[/b] – A more seamless and enjoyable experience!
[/list]

[b][h2]You can now leave a review on our Steam page! 🚀[/h2][/b]
We need [b]10 reviews[/b] by tonight—every review helps us grow! If you're enjoying the game, [b]drop a review[/b] and let us know what you think.


Thank you for your amazing support! ❤️🐑

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3177370/Sheep_Seeker_Demo/

notes.title: BETA is out !
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280994/336b714189a376902dfa32e111edc6952fda6d53.jpg[/img]
[h3]Sheep Seeker DEMO is Live! [/h3]

We’ve been working for a few months now to bring [b]Sheep Seeker[/b] to life, and now you can finally try it for yourself. It's a co-op game where you and a friend race against the clock to catch sheep.

The demo is ready, and we’d love for you to test it out. There are 5 levels waiting for you to explore, so grab a buddy, give it a go, and let us know what you think!

👉 Try it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3113650/Sheep_Seeker/

Thanks for all the support! 🐑
